note: Both sets capture the same three core facts correctly: the -3 dB corner definition, the 0.25 Hz corner frequency (roughly one-quarter of the blade's first edgewise natural frequency), and the 0.0125 s discrete time step with its Figure 7-1 condition. Set B adds a fourth claim that merely repeats the 0.0125 s time step with a fragmentary quote and drops the stated condition, adding no information. Both sets omit the state-space matrix definitions (A_d = α, B_d = 1−α, C_d = α, D_d = 1−α) and the recursive single-pole filter description. Set A is therefore cleaner and equally complete.
remarks: Both sets name the component 'Baseline Control-Measurement Filter', which does not appear on this page; the page calls it the low-pass filter / generator speed low-pass filter. If that name comes from elsewhere in the document it is fine, but it is not supported by this page's text. Both sets also skip the state-space matrix values and the 'recursive, single-pole filter' characterization, which are the main engineering facts of the page.
